items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: this friend of ours, the same Rogers Brackett that introduced us to Alec Wilder, called up and said, “listen, I’m doing a jingle tomorrow for Halo Shampoo and we’d like to have you guys sing on it.”

ctx.x: Well it seems that way, yeah. Thank you.

And we were there for 11 years, and it was a 15 minute ride to midtown, and a private drive when you got back there. I could leave in the morning, come back at lunch, go back into the City and do whatever you need, and we got into doing television commercials, because at one time we were about ready to go on a trip, to go on the road again, and this friend of ours, the same Rogers Brackett that introduced us to Alec Wilder, called up and said, “listen, I’m doing a jingle tomorrow for Halo Shampoo and we’d like to…
And our friend Don Payne wrote it too. He had written the jingle.
